posts.title: Reminders of how Beautiful People Can Be
posts.description: I live around people who fill me with deep despair. Watching people look at human life and suffering as a means to end or laughing/minimizing it. I cannot help but look at them as monsters who dare wear the face of a human even though I see none behind an obvious fake mask that they do not even buy themselves. People are capable of horror and causing pain beyond what our nightmares can conjure up

posts.title: Irrelevancy is Death
posts.description: Irrelevant is a word that haunts social media, the internet, elite circles of celebrities, and general popularity as well. Social media as we know it is around 20+ years old with juggernauts from the beginning now barely remembered or wading in the loose sand of the hourglass of being a topic in the ocean of commentary channels. Usually because of a clumsy comeback, as a mockery, or due to a felon

posts.title: My 4th Year in the NYC Pride March
posts.description: I've been doing this march for 4 years now and even I can't do the official city one, I want to still continue in the community, open to all marches across the city. This year I handed out stickers and rainbow wristbands with people giving me high-fives and some even giving me handmade bracelets.
